CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: selfhost/emit.prn: emit-let-bindings now supports plain function-call let-bindings (not just alloc calls) -- the dominant real blocker found via a real self-compile attempt of selfhost/lexer.prn (35 of ~57 errors). New plain-call-shaped?/emit-plain-call/mangle-call-name (strips /-qualified names to their real final segment, matching how the full compiler never module-prefixes generated defn names); vec/-qualified calls stay a deliberate, permanent #error exclusion (same collision-risk reasoning src/emit.c's own mangle_call_name already applies). 13 new assertions (26 total for domain 4), CI green on all 4 jobs. Real, measured progress: lexer.prn's self-compile error count dropped 57 -> 46, still doesn't compile -- non-symbol call args, match/cond as body forms, and an undeclared-identifier class remain, documented in NORTHSTAR.md. PARENA commit b3d7071, Apple #16383. session: sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)

⚓ ☃
